from scipy import stats

def apply_discard(data, discard):
    if not discard: return data
    drop=[2,17] # indices P3, C18
    keep=[i for i in range(data.shape[1]) if i not in drop]

def compute(data,Pmask,Cmask, norm='detected', use_high=True, missing_policy='drop'):
    # sample mean
    means=[]
    for j in range(data.shape[1]):
        vals=data[:,j]
        finite=~np.isnan(vals)
        if norm=='detected':
            finite=finite & (vals<34)
        elif norm=='all':
            pass
        if finite.sum()==0: means.append(np.nan)
        else: means.append(np.nanmean(vals[finite]))
    means=np.array(means)
    X = means[None,:] - data  # negative dCt, finite if data finite and mean finite
    raw=[]; names2=[]
    for i in range(data.shape[0]):
        x=X[i]
        if missing_policy=='drop':
            # include finite x; NAN rows removed
            xp=x[Pmask & ~np.isnan(x)]
            xc=x[Cmask & ~np.isnan(x)]
        elif missing_policy=='impute40':
            # treat all NAN as 40 for row? x from mean-40; data missing replaced 40 before norm?
            pass
        if len(xp)>=2 and len(xc)>=2:
            t,p=stats.ttest_ind(xp,xc,equal_var=True)
            raw.append(p); names2.append(names[i])

def adjust_counts(p, method):
    m=len(p)

    elif method=='bh':
        order=np.argsort(p); q=np.empty(m)
        prev=1.0
        for rank in range(m,0,-1):
            idx=order[rank-1]
            val=min(m/rank*p[idx],1)
            prev=min(prev,val)
            q[idx]=prev
    elif method=='by':
        order=np.argsort(p); q=np.empty(m)
        # c(m)=sum 1/i
        c=sum(1.0/k for k in range(1,m+1))
        prev=1.0
        for rank in range(m,0,-1):
            idx=order[rank-1]
            val=min(m*c/rank*p[idx],1)
            prev=min(prev,val)
            q[idx]=prev
    return q

for discard in [False, True]:

    for norm in ['detected','all','none']:

                    if norm=='detected': finite &= vals<34
                    if finite.sum()==0: means.append(np.nan)

            for i in range(data.shape[0]):

            for meth in ['bonf','bh','by']:

                sig=np.where(q<=0.05)[0]

    print('---')

import xlrd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

path='inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls'
book=xlrd.open_workbook(path)
sh=book.sheet_by_index(0)
# Rows: 0 title, 1 sample header, 2..176 miRNA rows
miRNAs=[]
mat=[]
for r in range(2, sh.nrows):
    miRNAs.append(sh.cell_value(r,0))
    vals=[]
    for c in range(1, sh.ncols):
        v=sh.cell_value(r,c)
        if isinstance(v,str) and v.strip().upper()=='NAN':
            vals.append(np.nan)
        else:
            vals.append(float(v))
    mat.append(vals)
A=np.array(mat)  # 175 x 20

def analyze(data, patient_cols, control_cols, use_detected_mean=True):
    # Per-sample normalization factor: mean Ct over all numeric values,
    # or only detected Ct<34, depending on paper wording.
    factors=[]
    for j in range(data.shape[1]):
        col=data[:,j]
        valid=~np.isnan(col)
        if use_detected_mean:
            valid &= (col < 34)
        factors.append(np.nanmean(col[valid]))
    factors=np.array(factors)
    # log2 mean-normalized expression is proportional to -(Ct - sample mean)
    expr=factors[None,:]-data
    pvals=[]
    for i in range(data.shape[0]):
        xp=expr[i, patient_cols]
        xc=expr[i, control_cols]
        xp=xp[~np.isnan(xp)]
        xc=xc[~np.isnan(xc)]
        t,p=stats.ttest_ind(xp,xc,equal_var=True)
        pvals.append(p)
    pvals=np.array(pvals)
    results={}
    for method in ['bonferroni','fdr_bh','fdr_by']:
        rej, adj, _, _ = multipletests(pvals, alpha=0.05, method=method)
        results[method]=(int(rej.sum()), [miRNAs[i] for i in np.where(rej)[0]])
    return pvals, results

# All provided samples: P_1..P_10 vs C_11..C_20
p1,r1=analyze(A, list(range(0,10)), list(range(10,20)), use_detected_mean=False)
print('all samples, mean all numeric: raw<0.05', int((p1<0.05).sum()))
for m in r1:
    print(m, r1[m])

# Paper-described haemolysis exclusions: remove P_3 (index 2) and C_18 (index 17)
keep=[i for i in range(20) if i not in (2,17)]
A2=A[:,keep]
p_cols=[keep.index(i) for i in range(10) if i"'!=2]
c_cols=[keep.index(i) for i in range(10,20) if i!=17]
p2,r2=analyze(A2,p_cols,c_cols,use_detected_mean=True)
print('"'excluded P3/C18, mean detected Ct<34: raw<0.05', int((p2<0.05).sum()))
for m in r2:
    print(m, r2[m])

print('ANSWER', r1['bonferroni'][0], ':', r1['fdr_by'][0])
print('ANSWER excluded', r2['bonferroni'][0], ':', r2['fdr_by'][0])
PY"
